bugLogs.title: Insufficient color contrast for stock status text and Add to Cart button
steps_to_reproduce: Locate the stock status paragraph "In Stock - Ships in 2 days"
Observe the text color (#cccccc) on a white background (#ffffff)
Observe the button text color (#ffffff) on orange background (#ff6600)
bugLogs.expected_behavior: Text and button label must have a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 against their background per WCAG 2.1 Success Criterion 1.4.3.
bugLogs.actual_behavior: Stock status text contrast ratio is 1.6:1 and Add to Cart button text contrast ratio is 2.93:1, both below the required 4.5:1.
bugLogs.suggested_fix: In the CSS rule for p, change color from #cccccc to #767676 (4.54:1 on #ffffff; measured 1.6:1, required 4.5:1).

bugLogs.title: Product image missing alternative text on product detail page
bugLogs.expected_behavior: Each informative must have a descriptive alt attribute that conveys the purpose of the image.
bugLogs.actual_behavior: The element has no alt, aria-label, aria-labelledby, title, or role override.
bugLogs.suggested_fix: Add a descriptive alt attribute, e.g., alt="Red running shoe, side view", to the img element: img.product-image[src='shoe-detail-red.jpg'] { alt='Red running shoe, side view' }

bugLogs.title: Quantity input lacks an accessible label on product detail page
steps_to_reproduce: Open the product-detail.html page in a browser
Navigate to the quantity selector input (type=number)
Attempt to focus the input using Tab or a screen reader
bugLogs.expected_behavior: The input should have a programmatically determinable label that is announced by screen readers and visible to all users.
bugLogs.actual_behavior: The <input type="number" ...> has no associated <label>, no aria-label, no aria-labelledby, no title, and no placeholder, leaving it unlabeled.
bugLogs.suggested_fix:
Add a visible label and associate it with the input, e.g.,
<label for="qty">Quantity</label>
<input id="qty" type="number" value="1" min="1" max="10" style="width: 50px;" aria-required="true">
